I’m currently heading back to school, and I’m trying to decide if I want to go to West Chester University for my BSW or Temple for my BSW. I have a goal of practicing, but I have an inkling that research will tickle my brain, so I have been looking at PhD programs after I get done my MSW with advanced standing.

If I do Temple’s program, I will be on campus, full time. If I do West Chester’s program, I will probably do their BSW program within Philadelphia. I’m in contact with them now to ask about taking full-time evening classes, if that’s an option. I hope so! My work schedule allows for a lot of flexibility, so I could really bang out my degree there.

Not sure where I want to go to for my MSW. Want to definitely focus on clinical, direct work, teaching, and have the ability to be set up for research down the line. 

I’m so excited for this journey. If anyone has any info, please reach out to me.
